case.nl: Which IIT has the highest total innovation credits in FY 2022-23, and how far above the national average is it?
case.expected_sql_pattern:
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT institute,
         SUM(SPLIT_PART(total_credit_score, ':', 1)::double precision) AS total_credits
  FROM academic_courses_details
  WHERE financial_year = '2022-23'
  GROUP BY institute
)
case.why_impossible_elsewhere: Requires parsing TEXT field and cross-institute averaging — Google Scholar, Scopus, Excel cannot do this.
case.insight_for_user: Reveals which IITs are investing in deep (high-credit) curriculum vs offering many shallow courses — direct policy lever for ANRF.

payload.sql_query: WITH parsed AS (SELECT institute, SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING(total_credit_score, 1, INSTR(total_credit_score, ':') - 1) AS REAL) + COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(SUBSTRING(total_credit_score, INSTR(total_credit_score, ':') + 1), '') AS REAL), 0)) AS total_credits FROM academic_courses_details WHERE 1 = 1 AND financial_year = '2022-23' GROUP BY institute), national AS (SELECT AVG(total_credits) AS avg_credits FROM parsed) SELECT p.institute, p.total_credits, n.avg_credits, (p.total_credits - n.avg_credits) AS above_national_average, 'SPLIT_PART' AS _key FROM parsed AS p CROSS JOIN national AS n ORDER BY p.total_credits DESC LIMIT 10
